Dularchand Yadav | Anant Singh | Veena Devi | Mokama Murder Case | Ground Report
Dularchand Yadav was murdered in Mokama. Dularchand was campaigning for his nephew, Piyush Priyadarshi, who had received a ticket from the Jan Suraj party. During the campaign, a dispute arose with supporters of Anant Singh in the Kotwal area, and Dularchand Yadav was shot and killed in what appears to be an election-related feud. Anant Singh has been accused of being involved in the shooting. To know more watch full report to what Veena Devi said about this matter to the Khabargaon team.
